output.sql:
SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(l.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM marts.fct_order_lines l
JOIN marts.fct_orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id
JOIN marts.dim_products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
ORDER BY units_sold DESC
LIMIT 1;
output.explanation: Joins order lines to orders to keep only lines from orders with status 'completed' and order_date in 2025, sums quantity per product, and returns the product with the highest total units. I assumed the status value is exactly 'completed'; I could not check the distinct status values, so confirm that spelling against the data.
